title: akuko view manifest
description: The manifest every akuko view embeds as <script type="application/json" id="akuko-view">. A view that writes decisions must offer every required view. The definitions below are the machine-readable view contract that scripts/check-view.mjs enforces: required views (ViewName), the data-akuko-field names each view must carry (fields:<view>), the decision controls (Action) and the five renderer rules (Rule). Prose: views/contract.md. Hand-written; the Decision record itself is views/decision.schema.json, generated from the Zod schema.

id.description: Stable view id, e.g. "default-board" or "freehand:cast-sheet". Decision.view is "<id>@<version>".

version.description: Bump it whenever the page changes; a conformance record covers one id@version and one exact HTML hash.

writes_decisions.description: True when the view has data-akuko-action controls. Such a view must pass check-view before it is published.

views.description: The views this page offers. A read-only freehand view may offer any subset.

ViewName.description: Required views of a review surface (01-plan §Board and views). Each is marked in the page with data-akuko-view="<name>".

Action.description: Values of data-akuko-action. Each control acts on exactly one unit or job (data-akuko-unit) and writes exactly one Decision with that action.

fields:pipeline.description: One stage element per stage (data-akuko-stage=<stage id>, data-akuko-status=<stage state>) and one current-stage marker (data-akuko-stage=<current_stage>).

fields:shots.description: One shot element per shot (data-akuko-unit=<shot id>) holding its status (data-akuko-status), shot type, duration and panel; one scene element per scene (data-akuko-unit=<scene id>).

fields:shot-detail.description: For the selected shot (data-akuko-unit on the view): panel, camera, action, duration, the screenplay line, the draft prompt, bible refs, the comment thread, its status; plus approve / request-changes / note controls when it is waiting for review or sent back.

fields:bible.description: One bible-entry element per character, location and style (data-akuko-unit, data-akuko-status). Every asset waiting for review has an approve control.

fields:spend-gate.description: One job element per pending_spend entry (data-akuko-unit=<job id>, data-akuko-status) with its estimate; the budget cap, what is spent, and what is left if you approve. Also sunk and in-flight when they are not zero. Every amount exactly, never rounded.

fields:ledger.description: One ledger-entry element per ledger entry, and the ledger total.

fields:script-link.description: One script-tag element per shot that has a screenplay line (data-akuko-unit=<shot id>); activating it selects that shot in shot-detail.

fields:your-move.description: Counts derived from the data, never typed: shots waiting for review, spend decisions waiting, other units (bible assets, entries) waiting. A count may be omitted when it is zero.

Rule.description: The five renderer rules every view obeys (views/contract.md §Renderer rules).

oneOf.description: Only a person can approve: no auto-approve, pre-ticked or batch approval; one explicit action per unit.
Money is never hidden or rounded: every paid job shows its estimate, the cap, what is spent and what is left if you approve.
A "your move" summary is always visible, derived from the data.
Decisions are written only through the decision format, never by editing akuko.json from the view.
